top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks flat; oil rises as Saudi Arabia and Houthis trade strikes
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to City AM‘s FTSE 100 live blog. Stocks are set to make modest gains on Wednesday morning, after the blue-chip index finished flat on Tuesday despite spending most of the day in the green. Oil prices are rising this morning, after the Iran-backed Houthi rebels fired missiles towards the headquarters of Saudi Aramco, [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
